''See also: [[Gold Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|In the context of [[sacred arts]], Gold represents the final stage of a practitioner's [[Path]]. Achieving this level requires a qualitative leap beyond the [[Jade stage]], accomplished by harvesting a [[Remnant]] and [[binding]] it to one's physical body. This process makes the practitioner more than mortal, as their bodies become partially composed of [[madra]]. Practitioners at this level are often identified by a [[Goldsign]]—a visible manifestation of their [[Path]] and the [[Remnant]] in their core. The [[Gold stage]] is divided into three sub-levels: [[Lowgold]], [[Highgold]], and [[Truegold]]. Advancement between these tiers is extremely difficult, with the gaps between them being significantly wider than previous stages of progression. While some consider Gold to be the pinnacle, others view it merely as a beginning. Beyond human practitioners, Gold is associated with various entities and materials. [[Gold dragons]] are known as tyrants who have ruled without opposition for long periods. Additionally, Goldsteel{{!}}goldsteel is a unique metal that appears to flash white when it catches the light; it is used by [[Soulsmiths]] for tools and armor because it can firmly grip [[madra]] and provide protection against [[Remnants]].}}

== Unsouled ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|Gold represents the ultimate stage of any [[sacred artist]]'s [[Path]]. Those who reach this level have mastered the secrets of [[madra]] to a degree that surpasses mortal [[dreams]], resulting in bodies that are partially composed of the substance itself. To achieve this final step, an artist must harvest a [[Remnant]] and bind it to their physical form. Although it is a pinnacle of achievement, Gold remains a level of power that can eventually be exceeded.}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|A [[Gold]] is someone who has mastered the secrets of [[madra]] beyond mortal [[dreams]].<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c10">''Unsouled'', chapter 10</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|[[Gold]] bodies are partially made of [[madra]].<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c10" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|[[Gold]] is a level of power that can be exceeded.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c17">''Unsouled'', chapter 17</ref>}}</li>

== Soulsmith ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|Gold represents a significant stage of [[advancement]] and a specific rank for martial artists, [[sacred artists]], and other practitioners. Achieving this level involves holding a [[Remnant]] within one's core and receiving a [[Goldsign]], which results in various physical changes. This stage serves as a measure of both [[spirit]] and body strength. Within the narrative, [[Tash]] holds this status, and [[Yerin]] has successfully crossed the threshold into the [[Gold stage]]. Furthermore, [[Yerin]] considers it an impressive feat should [[Lindon]] ever reach this level of progression.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">9</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|At the [[Gold stage]], one holds a [[Remnant]] in their core and receives a [[Goldsign]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c2">''Soulsmith'', chapter 2</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|[[Gold]] is a stage of progression for artists that causes physical changes.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c5">''Soulsmith'', chapter 5</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|[[Gold]] is a stage of [[advancement]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c7">''Soulsmith'', chapter 7</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|[[Gold]] refers to a level of martial artist.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c8">''Soulsmith'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|[[Gold]] is a stage or rank for [[sacred artists]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c9">''Soulsmith'', chapter 9</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|[[Yerin]] has crossed the threshold to [[Gold stage]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c10">''Soulsmith'', chapter 10</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|[[Gold]] is a stage of [[spirit]]/body strength.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c12">''Soulsmith'', chapter 12</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|[[Gold]] is a rank or status held by [[Tash]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c14">''Soulsmith'', chapter 14</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|[[Yerin]] would find it impressive if [[Lindon]] hit [[Gold]] someday.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c20">''Soulsmith'', chapter 20</ref>}}</li>
